rules.source: A customer must not be charged twice for the same order.
rules.meaning: For each order: there must be at most 1 charged event.

decisions.question: If an order is refunded, should the charge count be reset to allow a new charge on the same order?
decisions.why: Refunding a transaction reverses a previous charge, which may legitimately allow the business to attempt charging the order again.

example.label: PLACEHOLDER ONLY: no core boundary timeline or verdict was checked

decisions.question: Should installment payment plans be exempt from the single charge per order rule?
decisions.why: Installment payment methods inherently require multiple charges over time for the same order ID.

example.label: PLACEHOLDER ONLY: no core boundary timeline or verdict was checked

rules.source: A cancelled order must never be shipped.
rules.meaning: For each order: once a cancelled event has happened, a shipped event must never happen.

decisions.question: If an order is created again after being cancelled, does that lift the ban and allow it to be shipped?
decisions.why: Re-creating an order under the same order ID after cancellation might re-open the order and permit standard fulfillment.

example.label: PLACEHOLDER ONLY: no core boundary timeline or verdict was checked

rules.source: A refund must be completed within 24 hours of the request.
rules.meaning: For each order: every refund requested event must be followed by a refund completed event within 24 hours (one refund completed event covers every earlier open refund requested event).

decisions.question: If an order is cancelled, should that remove the 24-hour deadline to complete a requested refund?
decisions.why: Cancelling an order may cancel or supersede pending refund requests, removing the obligation to complete the refund within 24 hours.

example.label: PLACEHOLDER ONLY: no core boundary timeline or verdict was checked

decisions.question: If a new refund request is submitted before the previous one is completed, should the 24-hour deadline restart from the latest request?
decisions.why: Submitting a new refund request could extend or reset the 24-hour SLA window from the time of the latest request.

decisions.question: Should installment payments be exempt from the 24-hour refund completion requirement?
decisions.why: Installment payments often involve third-party lenders and extended processing flows that cannot meet standard 24-hour completion targets.
